title: Express signed session cookie
context: Hand-rolled signed cookie for an Express app (cookie-parser populates req.cookies). The value is `<base64url payload>.<base64url HMAC-SHA256>`; signatures must be compared in constant time, and a malformed or tampered cookie must be treated as logged out, never throw. Payload `exp` is in seconds since the epoch. The app must refuse to start without COOKIE_SECRET.
code: const payload = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ uid: userId, exp })).toString("base64url");
res.cookie("sid", `${payload}.${sign(payload)}`, { httpOnly: true, secure: true, sameSite: "lax" });

expected.why: a missing COOKIE_SECRET is not detected at startup; the app starts and only fails (or signs with undefined) at request time
Date.now() is milliseconds while exp must be seconds, so the cookie effectively never expires
timingSafeEqual throws when lengths differ and Buffer.from(undefined) throws when there is no dot, so a malformed cookie crashes the request
there is no return after the 401, so next() still runs the protected handler for anonymous users
